attempts.sql: SELECT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols c ON c.file_id = g.file_id AND c.name = 'Command' AND c.kind = 'class' JOIN code.symbols cm ON cm.file_id = c.file_id AND cm.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || g.name AND cm.kind = 'method' WHERE g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND g.name = 'Group' AND g.kind = 'class' AND g.qualname = 'Group' AND g.name <> 'Command' AND g.symbol_id <> c.symbol_id AND g.line_start > c.line_start AND g.line_end < c.line_end AND cm.line_start > c.line_start AND cm.line_end < c.line_end AND cm.symbol_id <> g.symbol_id

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds the Group class in src/click/core.py and the Command class in the same file, then matches each Group method name to a method defined directly in Command's body (by qualname and line range). Returns the symbol IDs of Group methods that override a Command-defined method of the same name.
sql: SELECT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols c ON c.file_id = g.file_id AND c.name = 'Command' AND c.kind = 'class' JOIN code.symbols cm ON cm.file_id = c.file_id AND cm.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || g.name AND cm.kind = 'method' WHERE g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND g.name = 'Group' AND g.kind = 'class' AND g.qualname = 'Group' AND g.name <> 'Command' AND g.symbol_id <> c.symbol_id AND g.line_start > c.line_start AND g.line_end < c.line_end AND cm.line_start > c.line_start AND cm.line_end < c.line_end AND cm.symbol_id <> g.symbol_id
